jobs.title: Learning Design & Training Product Manager
jobs.description: Location: Bracknell, UK (hybrid, 2 days per week in office) | Type: Full-time, 37.5 hour Reports to: Head of Portfolio The role in brief Most learning designers build courses. In this role, you will own them. As our Instructional Design & Training Products Manager, you will take a portfolio of professional training products from first idea to finished, quality-assured release, and keep them at their best for as long as they are in use. The training you build is used by aviation (civil and defence) professionals whose decisions keep people safe, so getting it right matters. You will work alongside some of the most respected subject matter experts in aviation safety, helping them turn deep technical knowledge into learning that is clear, engaging and works in the classroom, online and in blended formats. You will have real influence over how we design, develop and quality-assure our training, including how we use AI to do it better. If you have a background in learning design or training product development, a sharp eye for quality, and want to see your work make a visible difference, we would like to hear from you. Why this role matters This role owns the full lifecycle of a defined segment of our training and consulting portfolio. You will be the bridge between our subject matter experts and the wider business – sales, marketing and delivery – making sure every product is high-quality, ISO-compliant and commercially sound. Just as importantly, you will help make our portfolio more scalable, so that great products no longer depend on SMEs doing all of the development themselves. What you will do Own the product lifecycle: take a defined set of training and consulting products through design, development, QA, release and maintenance, delivering against timelines, budgets, quality standards and commercial goals. Identify learning needs: use training needs and gap analysis, customer insight and delivery feedback to shape new products and refresh and improve existing ones. Lead learning design with SMEs: turn expert knowledge into clear learning objectives, specifications, storyboards and design documentation. Shape new products: work with Business Development and SMEs to define market needs, build the case for new products and position them for sale. Create high-quality materials: presentations, workbooks, facilitator guides, lesson plans, marketing collateral and digital content. Champion quality: run QA, proofreading, brand, IP and publication checks before anything is released. Keep products current: manage version control, maintenance cycles and product KPIs. Improve the learner experience: raise the standard of design and usability across classroom, virtual and blended formats. Work smarter with AI: use AI tools to speed up development and reduce SME drafting time. What you will bring At least 2 years’ experience in training product development, instructional or learning design, or L&D content development. A track record of designing professional training materials for classroom, virtual or blended delivery. A solid grounding in learning design principles (for example ADDIE) and in training needs and gap analysis. A strong eye for quality and detail – you notice what others miss, from a weak learning objective to an inconsistent heading. Strong project management skills, and the ability to juggle several products, deadlines and stakeholders at once. Confidence working with subject matter experts: asking the right questions, challenging constructively, and turning expertise into effective learning. Advanced skills in PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Adobe Acrobat. Excellent written English, to publication standard. Nice to have Experience in aviation, defence or another safety-critical or regulated industry. E-learning or blended learning development experience. A recognised L&D or instructional design qualification. An understanding of IP and contract frameworks. Experience using AI in content development. What success looks like 90% or more of product milestones delivered on time. 100% of releases meet QA, brand and IP standards. A 40% reduction in SME effort on repeatable development tasks. Fewer maintenance requests and releases each year. AI used effectively across the development process. Positive feedback from stakeholders and learners on usability and quality. Join Baines Simmons Baines Simmons builds the competence behind aerospace and defence safety. For 25 years we have delivered expert, approachable training and consulting to civil and military aviation organisations worldwide: more than 750 organisations served, over 200,000 professionals trained, and 40 or more regulatory authorities advised. We work as one with our clients, sharing serious know-how, rigour and expertise. Across every sector, and alongside global regulators, we help organisations continuously improve safety, airworthiness and compliance. We go beyond helping them comply with regulations; we empower them to excel in operational and safety performance. We look for curiosity, passion, leadership and impact. Our people do not just advise on safety. They change how clients manage it. If you want your work to make a measurable difference to aviation safety, we would like to hear from you. One organisation, four brands Baines Simmons is one of four TrustFlight brands. TrustFlight is the Aerospace Safety Intelligence Platform, building the technology that helps aviation operate safely and stay compliant. Redline Assured Security delivers government-standard aviation security, and Kenyon International delivers crisis management and response. Each brand keeps its own name, heritage and team. Together we share one platform, one set of values and one purpose: closing the gaps between disconnected tools and providers, because those gaps are where risk accumulates. Working at Baines Simmons means your expertise connects to all four . Why people stay We believe people do their best work when they have the freedom to do their job without too many rules and barriers getting in the way. Our culture is built on empowerment and trust: we hire good people and expect them to make the right calls for the customer, company, and themselves. Transforming an industry means our people have to keep learning. We earn our clients' confidence by being honest and dependable with each other, and that includes caring about the important things in life outside of work. Our offices in the UK, Canada, the US and Jersey are where teams meet to collaborate and plan. People who deliver earn more say in how their career develops, from the path they take to the flexibility they need. If you want to make a real difference to safety, this is the place to be. How we work with AI TrustFlight is an AI-first organisation, and we provide AI training where it is appropriate for your role. In this role that means using AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Copilot and Gamma) to draft and structure content, accelerate documentation and reports, and support knowledge management, while critically reviewing and refining every AI-generated output for accuracy, clarity and professional quality. You will design and apply AI-enabled workflows that make product development faster and more consistent, look for new places to integrate AI into our processes, and share what works with the team. You will complete our AI fluency onboarding within your first 30 days and spend four hours a month experimenting with AI tools and building your skills. Where and how you will work Working hours: 37.5 hours per week, core hours 09:00–17:00 Work pattern: Hybrid, 2 days per week in our Bracknell office Travel: Occasional travel as required On-call or shift work: None Screening or clearance: Criminal record check required What we offer Competitive salary of £38,000 to £44,000 Generous holiday allowance Company pension contribution Healthcare cover for everyone, including dental and optical Support for personal career development Flexible working arranged with your manager Ready to apply? Send us your CV. We would also love a short cover letter telling us about a training product you designed and are proud of: what the need was, how you approached it, and what difference it made. jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - AI Platform
jobs.description: At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it. Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us! 📱 Our Product Team Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams. Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value: Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team. Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app. Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell. AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability. ⚡ The AI Platform tribe AI Platform's mission is to turn Joko into a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside. The tribe builds the internal agent infrastructure that will let every team work faster, automate complex workflows, and create new 0-to-1 features with AI. Its flagship product is Joker , Joko's internal AI teammate. Already live in Slack, Notion and Linear, Joker can understand context, use tools, act across systems, and take real work from idea to execution. The ambition is not just to automate repetitive tasks, but to make agents a new production layer for how Joko builds and operates. For this to work at company scale, AI Platform also owns the backbone underneath: Gotham , the identity and permission layer that lets agents act with exactly the access of the person they work for; plus the internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security, reliability and server-cost foundations that keep Joko fast, safe and scalable. The tribe's users are the teams inside Joko. Its goal is simple: help them run extremely efficient processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and give the company the leverage it needs to scale in the coming years. 🎯 What you will do As Lead Product Manager for the Platform tribe, your mission is to make Joko's own machine faster, safer and increasingly agentic. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, own the tribe's roadmap end to end, and lead the Product Managers on its task forces as the team grows. The tribe is being staffed right now, so expect to be hands-on from day one on scopes you own personally, and to build the function as the team grows. Set the tribe's strategy: You will decide what Platform builds, in what order, and what it stops doing. You will map what teams across the company do today in our internal tools, what it costs them and what they need next, then turn that into a roadmap you can defend in front of leadership. This intake runs permanently, as a standing part of the job. Own Joker and Gotham: These are the tribe's most strategic bets and you will drive them personally. Taking Joker from what it is today to a production-grade agent platform, and shipping Gotham's permission model so agents never hold more access than the person they act for, is the highest-leverage work in your scope. Build the automation layer: The approach is capability first: expose an action as a scoped tool, write the instructions an agent needs to use it well, then let the agent run the job. Interfaces come only where they earn their place, and deciding what still deserves a screen is a genuinely new kind of product judgment. Retire what should not exist: Part of the mandate is subtractive: migrating off tools that have outlived their purpose and progressively switching off legacy systems, without breaking the teams that depend on them every day. Own security, compliance and reliability: Identity and access, data retention and minimization, log centralization, audit, test coverage. The requirement often comes from Legal or an auditor, and still has to be shaped into something people will actually adopt. Lead and grow the team: You will hire, mentor and lead the Product Managers who own the tribe's task forces, set the bar on discovery and delivery, and be the person the tribe's engineers and designers look to for product direction. Be the interface for the whole company: You will be the point of contact for Engineering, Ops, Finance, Legal, Data and Care, structuring their demands and arbitrating between them. You will define success in time saved, cost removed, risk reduced and adoption by internal teams, and report on it in those terms. 👀 Who we're looking for Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers. A background on internal tools, back-office products, APIs, platforms or complex B2B products is a strong plus. AI fluency, hands-on: This scope is being rebuilt around agents, so this criterion carries the most weight. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you understand what agents are actually good and bad at, and you have opinions about where automation belongs and where a human interface still earns its place. Product for teams mindset: You are comfortable building for internal users, where the bar is efficiency, robustness and adoption rather than polish. Problems nobody outside the company will ever see still energise you. If what drives you is craft on a consumer surface seen by millions, this scope will frustrate you. Strong technical appetite: You are curious and hands-on with infrastructure, identity, permissions, reliability, security, compliance and data architecture. Coding is not required, but you need to understand how things work. Management: You have a proven track record in people management. You know how to grow Product Managers, set a high bar for rigor, and give direction without taking every decision yourself. Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization and saying no. You can navigate many dependencies, arbitrate between senior stakeholders, and make trade-offs explicit. Analytical & pragmatic: You are data-driven, impact-oriented, and you go straight for the real operational problem. Communication: You are a clear, structured communicator, able to translate complex technical topics into business impact for the exec team. Location: Based in France or Spain. Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional. Mindset: You are ownership-driven, resilient, and motivated by solving hard, unglamorous but high-impact problems that make the whole company better. You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better. 💎 Our perks (Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only) At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through: Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget. Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year. On top of that, we offer plenty of perks: 💸 Top-market compensation 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent …and much more, check the full list here ! 🤝 Our hiring process Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams). Step 2 – Role-specific assessments For non-engineering roles : A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design). For engineering roles : A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool). Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers. ☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture. Compensation: €78.3K – €125.9K • €78.3K – €125.9K Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
